descriptions.tsonnet_b35_ease_800d4734: Advances two coupled values on an object: the second (+184) is reduced by step times rate while above a limit record's floor, clamping to the floor and shortening the step by the shortfall over the rate (or zeroing the step); the first (+180) then advances by the remaining step, capped by the record's ceiling. Field meanings are inferred. Floating-point edge cases and the valid rate domain have not been behaviorally tested.
